prompts.boss-monarch:
Use case: identity-preserve / production game sprite. Use the attached approved Lumen concept board ONLY as the exact identity reference. Recreate the giant hollow monarch in the upper-right FINAL HALL panel with MAXIMUM fidelity. Critical: a tall airy branching gold crown with separated slender points and a delicate circular filigree halo BEHIND the head (NOT a broad solid gold disk); long completely empty pitch black vertical face slit; broad asymmetric old-gold pauldrons; glowing diamond amber chest core; thin skeletal clawed hands extended sideways; dark armor almost hidden by long broad tattered crimson cloak ribbons, pale frayed gold edges; tapering lower body, cloak spread wide. The user rejected an earlier small brown armored king: do not simplify this into a generic king, do not add a face, boots-focused pose, round solid sun disk, or compact closed cape. Match the elegant looming sinister silhouette and rich red/black/antique gold texture of this exact reference.
Output ONE real transparent RGBA PNG spritesheet, high detail, ideally3072x2560, exactly6 equal columns x5 equal rows =30 frames. Each cell holds the complete same actor at a consistent scale and centered baseline with transparent padding. Pixel-art illustration quality with deliberate sharp pixels, not tiny low-res retro sprites. No background, floor, hero, bullets, UI, letters or grid. Five rows in order: row1 idle breathing / floating with slight cloak motion6frames; row2 slow floating movement with cloak motion6frames; row3 casting arm gesture6frames; row4 taking a hit six subtle recoilframes (no solid white silhouette); row5 death dissolution/collapse sixprogressiveframes retaining some actor in lastframe. Hands, branch crown and cloak tails must never touch cell boundaries. Long bony fingers not solid mittens. Preserve the first idle silhouette as close to the reference as possible. True transparent background, no checkerboard. These are runtime assets, not a concept board.
prompts.castle-hall-floor: Use case: stylized-concept production game floor texture. Attached approved Lumen concept board is reference; look ONLY at the upper-right final hall FLOOR, below and around the giant monarch. Create the exact same dark crimson royal carpet composition as a separate runtime floor layer for a 2D top-down game. Square1024x1024 opaque texture filling the whole canvas, orthographic flat floor only, no perspective horizon. Nearly90percent of this hall is a continuous deep wine-red velvet carpet with subtle woven texture and restrained ornate antique-gold embroidery. A wide center aisle runs vertically all the way from bottom to top. The carpet broadens to side shoulders, with stepped inset corners like the reference. Two fine elaborate gold border lines outline this single broad carpet, with a few very large delicate centered baroque medallions along the middle and simple quiet smaller flourishes. The outer10percent is dark brown stone/parquet in narrow edge strips, low contrast. Moody dark burgundy and nearly black brown, tiny amber highlights, never bright orange flat parquet. Retain the exact reference colors and composition. DO NOT include boss, any character, candles, light sources, columns, walls, props, bullets, particles, shadows of subjects, UI, text, labels, border outside the floor, grid or sample swatches. Not a screenshot: a clean opaque production floor image, no alpha. Fine textured pixels consistent with the concept.
prompts.castle-hall-decor: Use case: production game environment props atlas, faithful to attached approved Lumen concept board upper-right final hall. Create SIX distinct isolated complete environment objects in a transparent RGBA sheet, EXACTLY3 equal columns x2 equal rows. Ideally1536x1024. Each cell512square, objects fully inside generous transparent padding, a consistent bottom baseline. Warm dark baroque palace pixel-art, detailed antique gold filigree, near-black mahogany wood, restrained rich burgundy cloth, candlelight from reference. Front/top-down three-quarter game perspective, same camera as the concept, NO isometric tilted base. Row1left: a tall imposing mahogany-black fluted column with many gold bands, high ornate golden capital and stone base, identical to concept high pillars, about4times taller than wide. Row1middle: a long red hanging banner with gold crown/spiral heraldic crest and rich gold embroidered trim, pointed lower end, small gold hanging crossbar. Row1right: a pale gray stone statue of a robed crowned guardian on a dark square pedestal, same small statues as concept. Row2left: a tall ornate golden standing candelabrum with FIVE lit wax candles and small warm flames, dark slender stem and weighty base, not giant bloom. Row2middle: a wide dark mahogany wall panel module with recessed wood rectangles and fine aged gold bevel lines, deep dark texture, complete rectangular standalone module, no room. Row2right: a wide palatial rear-wall niche/arch frieze with dark wooden panelling, recessed black space, antique golden decorative moldings, complete isolated architecture module with no banner/statue inside. Transparent background truly alpha, no gray boxes, no checkerboard, no floor plane, no characters, no UI, no text, no labels, no decorative cell borders. Keep objects separate, never overlap across cells. This is a game asset sheet, not a scene.
